sloka: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः ।हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः ।। ५.३८.७२।।।।
transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ ।hṛdayena gato rāmaṁ śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ ।। 5.38.72।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.
